findings.title: One life enters a communal measure
findings.claim: The two parallel conditionals make one living self the unit whose destruction or preservation is read at the scale of the whole human gathering: one life becomes the measure by which communal harm and communal protection are seen.
findings.mechanism: The focus carries the singular through نفس and the opposed actions through قتل and أحيا, while the repeated الناس جميعا supplies the independent totality. The preceding 5:31 likeness contact makes comparison an active operation, and the 5:29 burden of both sins connects one act to consequences beyond the immediate body.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see why the verse gives killing one and saving one the same whole-human reach without reducing the comparison to a numerical exaggeration.
findings.containment: This does not claim that individual persons are legally interchangeable, that the context replaces the focus's primary rule, or that the excluded b-w nominations establish blood retaliation. The communal measure is a contained interpretive effect of the paired focus clauses and their supplied pericope contacts.

epistemic.reason: The channel support is trusted and the retained focus and context carriers are supplied, but the communal-measure synthesis remains an interpretation rather than a direct lexical gloss.
